positioning: Premium, modern, responsive real estate fintech platform for fractional real estate investments and leverage-backed products. Mix of Stripe, Zerodha, Blackstone.

pages_and_sections.name: Home
sections: Hero: Navy to Emerald subtle gradient background. Large value prop. CTAs: 'Explore Opportunities' (Primary Green), 'Join Waitlist' (Secondary White Outline). Visual: 3D real estate isometric visual.
Trust Bar: Minimalist logos of Bank/NBFC partners, combined with AUM & investor stats (e.g., '10B+ Managed', '15k+ Investors').
How Fractional Works: Visual bento-box flow or step-by-step pipeline showing sourcing, fractioning, investing, and yielding.
Opportunities Preview: 3-4 premium glassmorphism property cards (Yield, IRR, Min Investment, Occupancy). CTA to 'Browse All'.
Leverage Product Teaser: High-contrast dark section explaining the upcoming leverage-based investment structure.
Footer: Comprehensive regulatory, compliance text, and deep links.

pages_and_sections.name: Opportunities
sections: Header: Clean filter controls (Location, Asset Type, Target IRR).
Grid: 6-8 sample property cards using a bento or masonry grid approach.
Property Cards: High-quality building image, tags (A-Grade, Leased), metrics (Yield, IRR), progress bar (Funding Status).

pages_and_sections.name: Leverage Product
sections: Explainer: Visual breakdowns showing base yield vs. leveraged yield.
Waitlist Form: High-conversion 'Get Early Access' card with email input.

pages_and_sections.name: About & Partners
sections: Mission: 'Real Estate Investing, Upgraded.' text pattern.
Team/Contact: Strategy call booking CTA and Partner With Us form.

pages_and_sections.name: Investor Dashboard
sections: Overview: Portfolio value, active investments, available balance.
Watchlist: Saved opportunities table with tabular-nums.

image_prompts_nano_banana.hero_building_shot: A sleek, cinematic, 3D isometric mockup of an A-grade commercial office building resting on a floating glass platform. The building is highly modern, featuring sheer glass facades reflecting a soft sunset, surrounded by glowing data lines and financial charts circling the base. Shot with a premium, hyper-realistic, luxury tech aesthetic, dark navy and emerald green ambient lighting.
image_prompts_nano_banana.dashboard_mockup: A futuristic, clean financial dashboard interface floating in 3D space, showing high-yield real estate investment charts, portfolio value, and IRR metrics. Soft glassmorphism UI elements, deep navy blue and emerald green accents, high-end wealth management platform look.
image_prompts_nano_banana.fractional_ownership_illustration: An abstract, premium 3D illustration showing a large commercial skyscraper being divided into glowing, golden puzzle pieces or fractional cubes, representing fractional ownership. Clean white and light gray background, luxury fintech styling, soft ambient occlusion shadows.
image_prompts_nano_banana.leverage_product_visual: A stylized 3D visualization showing a stack of investment blocks being multiplied by a glowing green lever or magnifying glass. Represents financial leverage in real estate. Minimalist, premium, corporate aesthetic.
image_prompts_nano_banana.partner_trust_visual: A sleek, high-contrast composition showing a golden handshake or a stylized institutional shield merging with a modern building, representing secure partnerships and trust in commercial real estate.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor Icons (e.g., Bank, ShieldCheck, ChartLineUp) as abstract trust/partner logos instead of generic image placeholders.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is loaded for headings and 'Satoshi' for body. Use next/font or standard import.
Enforce the 'Plain-Money' design pattern in text. Show literal sums (e.g., '14.5% IRR', '₹25,00,000 Min') visibly.
Implement the 'data-testid' attribute on ALL interactive elements (buttons, forms, links, dashboard tabs) using kebab-case role-based names.
For the Hero section, utilize the defined 'hero_gradient'. Make it feel premium, like a Stripe/Blackstone crossover.

Property cards should use standard image URLs from 'media_urls.office_buildings' but the AI-generated images mentioned in 'image_prompts_nano_banana' should be visually indicated by a sophisticated placeholder or implemented if the Nano Banana tool is connected.
